questions.prompt: How does Pete initially describe circus performers?
questions.evidence: I think they’re athletes with interesting skills … and costumes.
questions.explanation: Pete 的初始观点是他们是有特殊技能和服装的运动型表演者；他没有否认体能，也没有把表演说成赛跑。此时他尚不同意 Anna 的艺术家观点。
answers: As athletes with special skills and costumes.
options: As competitors in a running race.
As athletes with special skills and costumes.

questions.prompt: Which point do Anna and Pete agree on before resolving their main disagreement?
questions.evidence: But, still, they are very athletic – flipping and throwing each other around.
questions.explanation: Pete 说表演者体能很好，Anna 随即表示 I agree with you on that point。局部同意的是 athletic，不能扩大成两人已同意所有观点。

questions.prompt: What distinction does Kate make between circus performance and many sports?
questions.evidence: This is simply performing and having fun.
questions.explanation: Kate 前面说明其他体育项目在竞争，而这里是在表演和享受过程。她不是说马戏不需体能，也没有把它描述为有胜负队伍的比赛。
answers: Circus is about performing rather than competing.
options: Circus is about performing rather than competing.
Every circus act has a winning team.

questions.prompt: What does Piper say performers learn to do?
questions.evidence: we learn to embody characters, and to move fluidly and gracefully … in artistic ways.
questions.explanation: embody characters 是塑造、呈现角色，fluidly and gracefully 是流畅优雅地移动。这些是艺术表达的依据，与避免空中表演或统一运动服无关。
options: Avoid performing while in the air.
Replace all costumes with sports uniforms.

questions.prompt: How did Anna conduct the interview with Kate and Piper?
questions.evidence: I interviewed them right side up, Pete.
questions.explanation: Pete 误以为采访也倒挂着进行，Anna 用 right side up 更正为正常朝上的姿势。表演能倒挂不等于采访也倒挂，更没有说只用书信。
answers: With them the right way up.
options: With them the right way up.
While all three were hanging upside down.

questions.prompt: How does Pete’s opinion change by the end?
questions.evidence: You’re right, Anna. Oh, you’re right. It’s just so beautiful.
questions.explanation: 听过表演者的解释后，Pete 说 You’re right 并赞美表演美，说明接受了 Anna 的观点。这是观点变化，不是最初的反对意见。
answers: He accepts Anna’s view that the performance is art.
options: He accepts Anna’s view that the performance is art.
He stops watching before hearing the performers.
He decides circus is only a competitive sport.

sourceIssues.reason: Circus performer interviews are presented as VOA reporting. No third-party audio clearance or absence of background music has been independently listened to; keep audio on hold.
sourceIssues.quote: Recently, I went to a circus festival.

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item exact source evidence and language comparison

blindComparison.scope: Independent source-text solve; reviewer did not open the author key. No actual listening audition or difficulty calibration.
